subject: MSA: handoff for inspection rights & weekly evidence runbook
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novamed.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: samantha.kim@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA review — inspection rights + evidence cadence

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through the MSA redlines yesterday. Two items we need to lock down before legal pushes this through on our side:

1) Inspection window & on-call/legal contact: we need a documented point of contact from Redwood for any live inspection requests and an escalation path if SOC 2 auditors surface an issue.
2) Evidence cadence: NovaMed's InfoSec has asked for a lightweight weekly evidence "runbook" for the first 90 days post-SLA to validate logs, config snapshots, and penetration-test dates.

Can you confirm: who will be our weekly evidence contact and whether Redwood can accept a sampling-based approach for incidents (i.e., NovaMed can request 2–3 sampled weeks of logs rather than full continuous export)?

If you prefer, we can sign the redline MSA pending a short exhibit addendum describing the evidence runbook and contact rotation.

Best,
Evan

--
Evan Brooks
Head of Procurement, NovaMed Health
evon.brooks@novamed.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA review — inspection rights + evidence cadence

Evan — thanks, that helps. Quick answers and a proposed next step below.

1) On-call / inspection contact:
- Primary: Security Ops on-call -> security-oncall@redwood.com (mon-fri 08:00-18:00 PT)
- Escalation: Legal Intake -> legal-intake@redwood.com (for subpoena/contract escalations)

2) Evidence cadence and sampling approach:
- We can support a 90-day onboarding runbook with weekly evidence exports (logs + config snapshots + SOC 2 artifact references).
- For sustained operations, we propose a sampling approach: NovaMed can request up to 3 sampled weeks per quarter for deep exports; for urgent incident investigations we will provide targeted exports for the affected windows.

Proposed next step: Laura, Karthik, and I drafted a short addendum (attached) that mirrors the MSA language but captures the weekly runbook, sampling rules, and the on-call rotation. Evan — if that looks good we can: 
  - mark the redlines as accepted pending the addendum,
  - send a DocuSign envelope for the addendum only,
  - shepherd evidence requests into a shared Drive folder for the first 90 days.

I've attached the current Security Exhibit draft and the NovaMed evidence template you shared with us — I annotated where we recommend the sampling language.

Thanks,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Manager, Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA review — inspection rights + evidence cadence

Looping in a couple details from legal/ops perspective — see inline bullets.

- Legal (Laura): we can accept the sampling model but need explicit language: maximum sampled weeks per quarter, notice window for requests (48–72 hours), and a clause for emergency requests tied to incident response.
- Compliance (Karthik): confirm that pen-test schedules in the exhibit are aligned with our internal testing calendar; if NovaMed requires an external pen-test copy we need timebox for evidence delivery (typically 10 business days for historical pen-test artifacts).
- Ops (Priyom): we'll set up the Drive folder and a small RBAC group for the shared evidence exports. Priyom — can you own the Drive onboarding and invite Evan + Samantha?

Evan — if you can confirm acceptance of the sampling caps and the 72-hour notice window, Laura and I will finalize the addendum language and route to DocuSign.

Short call option: we can run a 20-min alignment call tomorrow to finalize the flow if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novamed.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: samantha.kim@novamed.com
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA review — inspection rights + evidence cadence

Thanks Marissa — that all sounds reasonable. Three small asks from NovaMed side: 

1) Sampling cap: 3 sampled weeks / quarter is acceptable.
2) Notice window: 72 hours is fine. For emergencies we reserve the right to request additional windows with evidence of active incident investigation.
3) Pen-test artifacts: please confirm the 10 business day SLA for historical pen-test deliverables.

We'd prefer to get the addendum signed this week if possible. I'll run the language past our counsel first thing and confirm by noon PT. If you can send the DocuSign for the addendum only, that would speed things up.

—Evan
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novamed.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MSA addendum & DocuSign link (Redwood Security Exhibit)

Evan — attaching the finalized addendum and sending the DocuSign envelope now. Quick summary of the commitments in the addendum: 
- Weekly evidence runbook for the first 90 days; drive onboarding handled by Redwood Ops.
- Sampling model: up to 3 sampled weeks / quarter; 72-hour notice for scheduled requests; emergency exception for active incidents.
- Pen-test artifacts: 10 business day SLA for historic pen-test reports; live pen tests will be scheduled 30 days out with notice to NovaMed.
- On-call contacts: security-oncall@redwood.com primary; legal-intake@redwood.com escalation.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCD-1234-efgh (sent to Evan + Samantha)

Please sign and let us know if you want the separate 20-min alignment call; otherwise we'll consider this ready to execute.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Agreements
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
